user.title: Komeco Connect
user.description: Use your Komeco account email and password. Supported devices are auto-discovered (currently gas heater only).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Komeco API

init.title: Komeco Connect options
init.description: Cloud works with the official Connect Komeco account. LAN mode is experimental: stock heaters usually have no inbound LAN API yet. Use Auto to prefer LAN when a local bridge answers, otherwise keep using the cloud.

error.lan_host_required: LAN host is required for LAN or Auto mode
error.lan_unreachable: LAN host did not answer the experimental local protocol
